'''Tazan City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. A group of agents from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] landed in the city before [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrating]] and attacking the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] located to the west of the city.

==Description==
Tazan City was located on [[Tazan]], an undeveloped and sparsely populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Located within the [[City/Legends|city]] was [[Old Town (disambiguation)|Old Town]], nestled between the [[Central Business District]] and the [[Tazan starport]]. Also located next to the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was [[Startown]], and an [[Industrial Belt]] ran through the city, with a number of suburbs around its outskirts. These were well spaced and included the low-income residential area known as [[Desander Section]], which neighbored Old Town, and, arranged clockwise from there, the [[Lysander Section|Lysander]], [[Logan's Vale Section|Logan's Vale]], [[Bellmont Section|Bellmont]], and [[Fentella Section]]s. These sections were linked by [[Tree/Legends|tree]] lined avenues, with [[Pubtrans flitter]]s and rental [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] available in the city for transport.<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />

==History==
{{Quote|Yes? Can I help you?|Willer Clines greets the Rebel agents|<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />}}
Sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]], located outside of Tazan City, was [[Mission to Tazan|targeted]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who dispatched a team of agents to the planet. Landing in the Tazan starport in the ''[[Flying Fish]]'', the team made contact with the Rebel sympathizer [[Willer Clines]], an occupant of Desander Section; however, Clines' daughter [[Jastina Clines|Jastina]] had been kidnapped by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], who were aware of his contacts with the Alliance.<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />

The Imperials also stationed a contingent of [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] inside his [[Willer Clines' House|house]] in order to capture any Rebels that turned up, and a brief [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued. Despite this setback, the Rebels were able to continue their mission and infiltrate the Imperial base outside the city.<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />

==Inhabitants==
The city was mostly occupied by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and well as some [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], a number of which were employed at the Imperial Data Processing Center located 50 kilometers west of the city. A number of other [[Species/Legends|species]] also visited the city as [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] making use of the starport facilities.<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tazan City appears in the [[2001]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] ''[[Ultimate Core Dump]]'', written by [[Megan Robertson]] for the [[RPGA]] affiliated with [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The city is the setting for a number of encounters during the adventure, for which the outcomes are often left open. For instance, during the ambush at Clines' house, the players may either defeat the stormtroopers or get captured, or some combination thereof. Even if the players are captured, they still get a chance to continue with their mission, just continuing with an encounter in which they break out of a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell. The ultimate conclusion of the adventure is also left open.<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump" />
